annotations.title: Open a spółka z o.o. in Poland: steps and fees

description: Gives the steps to open a Polish spółka z o.o. from the number of shareholders and the share capital (from 5,000 zł, paid in full). Returns the S24 route next to a notarial deed (court fee 250 zł or 500 zł, PCC at 0.5% of the capital less the court fee; the notary's own fee is not estimated), the deadlines after the KRS entry (capital, PCC-3, ZUS, CRBR, NIP-8, VAT-R), CIT figures on one example profit, what Norman does next (the values for the S24 articles, the links for the other signers, and the PCC-3, NIP-8, ZUS and CRBR files), and continueInNorman, a link that opens Norman's sp. z o.o. planner with this plan. The founders sign and file in S24 or at a notary themselves; the tool files nothing and checks no company name. Rules only: nothing is saved, and the result is general information without a recommendation of a tax form, CIT rate or ZUS scheme, not legal or tax advice. The inputs hold no personal data: there are no fields for names, PESEL, NIP, addresses or email.

businessPurpose.description: What the company will do, in one concrete sentence.

companyName.description: Planned name of the company, not a person's name.

founders.description: Number of shareholders; Norman's planner supports up to 5.

idea.description: The user's business idea in their own words.

shareCapital.description: Share capital in whole złoty, at least 5,000.

year.description: Year of the rules and rates: 2026.
